name: MAGQA
description: Multi-Answer Grounded Video Question Answering (MAGQA) is a benchmark task designed to evaluate the real-time response ability of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) in a video-text duet interaction format, where video playback and text interactions alternate continuously.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark from the VideoLLM literature that is mainly used in recent research on real-time multimodal question answering, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Focuses on real-time video comprehension and interaction; supports continuous video-text duet format.
